Estimate GPU VRAM Requirements for Local Open-Weights LLM Deployment

Source: R/workflow.R
estimate_vram_requirements.Rd

Estimates total GPU VRAM (in gigabytes) needed to serve a local open-weights LLM under Ollama, llama.cpp, or vLLM as a function of model parameter count (in billions), weight quantization (Q4_K_M, Q6_K, Q8_0, FP16), context window length, concurrent batch size, and KV-cache precision, helping research labs size lab workstations and HPC GPU requests cleanly before launching air-gapped containers.

Usage

estimate_vram_requirements(
  params_b,
  quantization = c("Q4_K_M", "Q6_K", "Q8_0", "FP16"),
  context_length = 4096L,
  batch_size = 1L,
  n_layers = NULL,
  kv_cache_quant = c("FP16", "Q8_0", "Q4_0"),
  overhead_gb = 1.2
)

Arguments

params_b

Positive numeric model parameter count in billions (e.g., 8 for Llama-3.1-8B, 14 for Qwen-2.5-14B, 70 for Llama-3.1-70B).

quantization

Character scalar weight quantization format: "Q4_K_M" (default), "Q6_K", "Q8_0", or "FP16".

context_length

Positive integer sequence context window in tokens (default 4096L).

batch_size

Positive integer number of concurrent requests / batch sequences held in KV cache (default 1L).

n_layers

Optional positive integer transformer layer count. When NULL (default), inferred from typical GQA open-weights architectures scaled by params_b.

kv_cache_quant

Character scalar KV-cache precision: "FP16" (default), "Q8_0", or "Q4_0".

overhead_gb

Non-negative numeric framework/CUDA/activation memory overhead in GB (default 1.2).

Value

An S3 object of class "airgap_vram_estimate" with params_b, quantization, context_length, batch_size, kv_cache_quant, weights_gb, kv_cache_gb, overhead_gb, total_vram_gb, recommended_gpu_tier, and fits_tiers (tibble).

Examples

estimate_vram_requirements(8, quantization = "Q4_K_M", context_length = 8192L)
#> <airgap_vram_estimate>
#>   Model:            8B parameters (Q4_K_M, 32 layers)
#>   Context / Batch:  8192 tokens x 1 (KV: FP16)
#>   Weights VRAM:     4.47 GB
#>   KV-Cache VRAM:    1.00 GB
#>   Runtime Overhead: 1.20 GB
#>   Total Estimated:  6.67 GB
#>   Recommended Tier: 8 GB (Workstation RTX 4060 / 16 GB Unified)
estimate_vram_requirements(70, quantization = "Q4_K_M", context_length = 4096L, batch_size = 4L)
#> <airgap_vram_estimate>
#>   Model:            70B parameters (Q4_K_M, 80 layers)
#>   Context / Batch:  4096 tokens x 4 (KV: FP16)
#>   Weights VRAM:     39.12 GB
#>   KV-Cache VRAM:    5.00 GB
#>   Runtime Overhead: 1.65 GB
#>   Total Estimated:  45.77 GB
#>   Recommended Tier: 48 GB (L40S / A6000)
